chapter: Looking back: rock, blues, childhood and guitar innovators
title: Correcting Chilton's Who's Who entry; Lee Collins and New Orleans trumpeters
summary: Willard checks his mother's name (Gorham) and his entry, and he identifies New Orleans trumpeters like Lee Collins who moved to Chicago.

G-o-r-h-a-m, Gorham. Yeah. Well, this one -- we'll mark one up for Leonard, dear old Leonard. Oh, you did get this Chilton book. I have never seen that book. Is it-- where did you find it. Yeah, I'd love to see it. Yeah. Well, that's good. I don't know how factual it is, I
